text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started — rollout r12345: model-service v4.7.2 -> prod (20% traffic, eu-west-1 group A). Canary window 15m. OPs runbook: https://console.redwood/internal/runbooks/deploy-rollout r=jenkins #deploy-env

eli: seeing a spike in 503s and p95 latency on model-service in eu-west-1 at ~2m after start. Grafana dash: /d/model-svc/prod-latency (link).

sara: on it. which hosts?

eli: mostly pod-ids model-svc-56f9 and -62c1, logs show repeated "kv-cache OOM" and grpc: "stream closed by server". snippet:
```
2026-03-15T18:22:41Z ERROR kv_cache.cpp:142 cache_alloc failed size=4194304
2026-03-15T18:22:41Z WARN worker.cpp:88 grpc::StatusCode::UNAVAILABLE: stream closed by server
```

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: SRE-PAGE (sev-2) — 503 spike & degraded throughput on model-service (eu-west-1) — incident assigned to oncall.

mike: can we flip the rollout ff immediately? if it's a config/alloc bug in v4.7.2 we should stop traffic. command: `ffctl set rollout_r12345 disabled --reason "503s on canary"`

sara: doing that now.

sara: `ffctl set rollout_r12345 disabled` -> success :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Feature flag rollback acknowledged, redirecting new traffic to stable variant v4.6.9. Auto-fallback in progress.

eli: after ff flip, errors dropped back to baseline in ~45s. p50/p95 back to normal. I still see a handful of hung kv-cache allocations from the bad pods but new pods on v4.6.9 look healthy.

support-bot: Customer impact summary (prelim): ~0.3% of requests in eu-west-1 returned 5xx during 18:22–18:24 UTC. Affected customers: a small subset of API keys (12 keys) — support ticket queue has 3 inbound reports so far.

mike: good catch. we should capture pod-level core dumps and upload to S3 for postmortem. eli can you snapshot logs and the kube events? commands: `kubectl logs -l app=model-service -n prod --since=1h > /tmp/model-logs.txt` and `kubectl get events -n prod --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp`

eli: grabbing logs and creating bundle. uploading to s3: `s3://redwood-incident-bundles/r12345-1768001234.tar.gz`

kim: i'll take the 23:00 UTC handoff. can someone summarize side effects and open tasks?

sara: TL;DR:
- What happened: v4.7.2 rollout caused kv-cache alloc failures on a small subset of pods, causing grpc streams to close and a brief 503 spike.
- Mitigation: feature-flag disabled at 18:23 UTC, auto-fallback to v4.6.9 completed; traffic normalized by 18:24:30 UTC.
- Customer impact: ~0.3% errors in eu-west-1, 12 API keys impacted, ~3 tickets.
- Evidence: logs and core dumps uploaded -> s3://redwood-incident-bundles/r12345-1768001234.tar.gz; grafana snapshots saved.
- Next steps before handoff: collect heap profiles from v4.7.2 staging, reproduce kv-cache alloc pattern under load, add additional guard in runtime to fail-fast on low cache memory; run a canary with larger memory limits.

mike: added incident ticket INC-176800 on JIRA and linked runbook + s3 bundle. assigned to eng-runtime (eli, sara) for postmortem.

eli: quick note — the bad pods had `--kv-cache-size=4MB` due to a templating bug in the helm chart for that rollout. seems like default config got overwritten for that subset. reproducing locally now.

kim: thanks. i'll take ownership of customer comms and coordinate updates with support. i'll also monitor for any regression in the next 3h.

sara: handoff to @kim at 23:00 UTC. I'll keep this thread pinned with most recent diagnostics and we'll do a retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall -> kim at 23:00 UTC. If anything spikes, escalate to SRE lead @mike.

mike: please add a pre-deploy check to the chart CI that validates `--kv-cache-size` isn't below 16MB for prod-class nodes. quick patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/model-service/pull/4321 (WIP).

eli: noted. i'll attach the repro steps and the failing helm values to the ticket.

sara: closing immediate pager — root cause likely config drift in chart values for rollout r12345. Will follow up with postmortem and owners. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Updating affected customers: 3 support tickets acknowledged, templated response queued.

mike: thanks team. great quick action.

kim: picking up monitoring; will post summary update at 23:15 UTC or sooner if anything changes.

sara: end of thread updates: keep channel for followups only.
